_about: Edit this file to add your own events. Dates are IST (YYYY-MM-DD). Verify exchange holidays on the NSE circular. Weekly Nifty expiry (Tuesday) is computed automatically from the holidays below.

events.title: US Fed (FOMC) rate decision
events.note: Announced 2:00 pm New York time, about 11:30 pm IST. Expect a volatile gap or whipsaw on the next morning.

events.title: Diwali Muhurat trading (Sunday, timings by NSE circular)
events.note: Special one-hour session on a Sunday. The market is closed on Monday and also on Tuesday 10 Nov.

events.title: Last date for Q2 results (SEBI limit)
events.note: Most companies report their July-September quarter before this date: check each stock's board-meeting notice.

events.title: RBI MPC policy decision
events.note: MPC meets 2 to 4 December. Banks, NBFCs, realty and autos react most.

events.title: US Fed (FOMC) rate decision with projections
events.note: Announced 2:00 pm New York time on 9 December, about 12:30 am IST on 10 December.
